judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after generating the planning/TDD artifacts (`.lore/dod.md`, an acceptance test file `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`, and partial updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`) without implementing any of the production code. None of `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, or `src/config.ts` were touched. Consequently, the new acceptance tests will fail at runtime (and likely fail typechecking due to passing `history` into `HalServerOptions` via a type intersection workaround while the server ignores it), and almost none of the issue's acceptance criteria are met.
